listing.name: Real Steel — ReCompiled Steel (tokeneffortports)
listing.summary: The project advertises Vulkan, multiplayer and mods. Complete-game coverage is unknown. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own Real Steel Xbox 360 XBLA package or its complete extracted files. Mandatory title update; add-ons optional; exact update identity unknown.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use the offered platform package to import your own Real Steel game and mandatory title update. Add-ons are optional. Whether this setup compiles game code locally has not been confirmed.

warnings: The project advertises Vulkan, multiplayer and mods. Complete-game coverage is unknown.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.

references.title: Prepare the Real Steel Android package
references.instruction: ReCompiledSteel v0.2.0 publishes ReCompiledSteel-android-arm64-0.2.0.apk. Select the folder containing your own Xbox 360 game and its title update in Install game files. The project puts the imported data in its RealSteel folder. After setup, use Start in the app.
